task: There is a bug in src/stats.ts: median() returns the wrong value for lists with an even number of elements (it should return the mean of the two middle values). Fix the bug and run the tests.
lastMessage:
I fixed `median()` so it returns the mean of the two middle values when the list has an even number of elements. All 6 tests pass.

- **The fix** (`src/stats.ts:10`): for even-length lists it now returns `(sorted[mid - 1] + sorted[mid]) / 2`. Odd-length lists still return the single middle value, as before.
- **New test** (`test/stats.test.ts`): none of the existing tests used an even-length list, which is why they didn't catch the bug. I added one: `median([4, 1, 3, 2])` should equal `2.5`.

I haven't committed anything.
